notes.content:

notes.title: Steam Workshop Support
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I'm excited to announce that the Steam Workshop support for Melatonin is now live! You can visit the official [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1585220/workshop/]Melatonin Steam Workshop page[/url] to browse user created levels made by the community. 

Access your downloaded levels from the Title Screen through the "Extras" menu. To upload levels to the Workshop, simply use the "More" tab in the Level Editor. Have fun and come chat with the community on the official [url=https://discord.gg/3s4mRqyyQz]Discord Server[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40203716/582c36cea34e3317f4750738d49a41e7e202d005.png[/img]

notes.title: Level Editor Music
notes.content:
The latest build of Melatonin allows PC players to use their own song files in the Melatonin Level Editor! This feature just requires you to know the exact tempo of the song you selected.

Other features and ways to share levels with the community is still being worked on. Stay tuned and check out the roadmap for what else is coming up: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1585220/discussions/0/6126615404771467641/

notes.title: Level Editor Update
notes.content:
After some robust testing on the [url=https://discord.gg/3s4mRqyyQz]Half Asleep Discord server[/url], the level editor now includes the ability to edit each mashup in the game! You can switch between different dream worlds using the same tools already present in the game.

Just simply select the editor option when entering a mashup. More enhancements coming to the editor down the road including custom music. Thanks for your patience.

notes.title: Melatonin offers lofi beats to tap in rhythm to
notes.content:
More than half the rhythm games I see on PC seem to feature courses that look like bullet hell levels, designed for players with the perseverance, patience and 12-fingered hands I lack. Melatonin looks more my pace, with pastel hand-drawn art, chill beats, and levels about dreams and reality merging together. It's out now.

Read more

notes.title: Scoring bug hotfix (Windows)
notes.content: Windows: Scoring in the hard mode for "Exercise" was bugged. Now it will be correctly scored.

notes.title: Melatonin is OUT NOW for PC/Mac!
notes.content:
Available on PC/Mac for $14.99 USD. Get it within the new few weeks for a limited time [b]10% off[/b] discount! Feel free to report bugs and leave feedback on Steam discussion forums or post in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/3s4mRqyyQz]Offical Discord Server[/url]. It helps a lot if you could also leave a review on Steam.

Melatonin is fully compatible with Steam Deck and even includes a display mode calibrated for the Steam Deck screen in the settings menu. It is also available on the Epic Games Store and will be coming soon to the Nintendo Switch. Have fun!

Also wanted to put together a list of some of the things I'll be working on for post-release content. If you're looking for more content from Melatonin, here are some of the free new content and features currently planned.

[h3]Editor[/h3]
[list]
[*] Custom music support
[*] Editor support for mashup/remix levels
[/list]
[h3]Levels[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fun new twists on existing levels that I'll share more details on down the road
[/list]
[h3]Accessibility[/h3]
[list]
[*] Input tests for calibration
[*] Screen reader support
[*] Localizations
[/list]
[h3]Technical[/h3]
[list]
[*] 16x10 support
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Quicker level and chapter select
[/list]

notes.title: Here's a rhythm game powered entirely by chill vibes
notes.content: Here's a cute game coming this week: Melatonin, a rhythmic indie that is for all appearances powered entirely by chill vibes and doodles of pizza. It's composed of miniature rhythm games united by the overall aesthetic and dreamlike themes, but also by an interesting twist: It doesn't have the overlays you'd expect from a rhythm game... Read more.

notes.title: Melatonin releases DECEMBER 15th on PC
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce that Melatonin be releasing on December 15th on PC for $14.99 USD! There will also be a temporary launch discount of 10% off. The release date for the previously announced Nintendo Switch version will be coming very soon. 

Thank you so much for all the follows and wishlists so far. I honestly never imagined I would get that many. Hope you all enjoy the final game!
